mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates and boosts valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market tightness that accelerates wage growth and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of UNRATE < 3.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >50% of joint HOUST/RSAFS growth periods, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 305), aggressive Fed rate hikes (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) trigger market corrections, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >50% of CPIAUCSL > 305 AND FEDFUNDS > 5.0% periods, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >50% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales index (RSAFS) indicates sustained consumer spending strength that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of RSAFS growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal accelerating wage pressures that trigger Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >50% of joint UNRATE decline/PAYEMS growth periods, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of INDPRO decline periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.
